question: Who authored the book 'To the Seventh Generation: The Journey of Christian Medical College Vellore', released in January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. V I Mathan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. V I Mathan** is the author of the book "**To the Seventh Generation: The Journey of Christian Medical College Vellore**," which was released in **January 2025**.
 
• The book chronicles the history and evolution of **Christian Medical College (CMC) Vellore**, a premier medical institution in India that has made significant contributions to healthcare and medical education.
 
• Dr. Mathan, a renowned medical professional, has been associated with CMC Vellore and has an in-depth understanding of the institution's legacy and impact.
 
• CMC Vellore was founded in **1900** by **Dr. Ida Scudder**, an American missionary, with the aim of providing quality healthcare to underserved populations.
 
• The book highlights the institution's journey through seven generations, showcasing its commitment to excellence, innovation, and service to humanity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Christian Medical College (CMC) Vellore:**

 
 
• **Location:** Vellore, Tamil Nadu, India.
 
• Founded in **1900** by **Dr. Ida Scudder**, the institution initially started as a one-bed clinic and gradually expanded into a world-renowned medical college and hospital.
 
• CMC Vellore is known for its pioneering medical research, innovations, and focus on community health.
 
• The institution has introduced several groundbreaking medical procedures, including the first reconstructive surgery for leprosy patients in India.
 
• It is ranked among the top medical colleges in India and globally recognized for its quality healthcare services and education programs.
 
 
 
• **Dr. V I Mathan:**
 
 
• A distinguished medical professional and scholar associated with CMC Vellore.
 
• His contributions to the field of medicine and education have been widely acknowledged.
 
• The book "**To the Seventh Generation**" reflects his deep understanding of CMC Vellore's history and ethos.
 
 
 
• **Dr. Ida Scudder:**
 
 
• Dr. Ida Scudder was a pioneering American missionary and medical doctor who founded CMC Vellore.
 
• Her vision was to provide compassionate healthcare to the underserved and train medical professionals to continue this legacy.
 
• She is remembered for her dedication to improving healthcare access in India, particularly for women and children.
 
 
 
• **Legacy of CMC Vellore:**
 
 
• The institution has shaped healthcare delivery in India through its innovative practices and research.
 
• It emphasizes community-oriented healthcare and serves as a model for medical education and hospital management.
 
• CMC Vellore remains committed to fostering ethical and compassionate care, upholding its founding values.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Themes of the Book:**

 
 
• The book emphasizes the transformative role of CMC Vellore in Indian healthcare over seven generations.
 
• It documents the institution's achievements, challenges, and its unwavering commitment to its founding principles.
 
• The narrative highlights the importance of ethical medical practices, community service, and innovation.
 
• It serves as an inspiration for medical professionals and institutions globally.
 
 
 
• **Impact of CMC Vellore:**
 
 
• CMC Vellore has significantly influenced healthcare delivery and education in India.
 
• It has trained thousands of medical professionals who continue to contribute to healthcare worldwide.
 
• The institution is recognized for its role in addressing public health challenges and advancing medical research.
